messages:
Marta (CS): Hey team — Harvestly is doing a 2-week APAC pilot tomorrow and asked for a temporary QPS bump + IP allowlist so their demo doesn't get throttled.

Sachin (Harvestly): Thanks! We'll be ramping traffic from 2026-04-01 to 2026-04-15. Primary egress IPs: 34.120.45.0/24 and 34.120.46.0/24. Expected sustained QPS ~ 60, peaks ~ 150. Beta env only.

Devin (SRE): Noted. Which region should the peering/allowlist be applied to? ap-east or ap-southeast?

Marta (CS): ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) — that's where their clients are. Can we provision a soft QPS increase to 75 sustained and a peak window to 200 for the date range? We'll auto-revoke after 2026-04-15.

Alec (Infra): ok. I need an internal ticket and the account ID. Marta, can you create the ticket with these fields? I'll attach the firewall change. Also add "expire" tag so it gets auto-rolled back.

Marta (CS): Created ticket INF-8421, link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8421 — included account: harvestly-prod (acct_8hjK2). Tagged `temp-qps` and `auto-revoke:2026-04-15`.

OpsBot: Ticket INF-8421 transitioned to In Progress by Alec (Infra).

Alec (Infra): Prep config below — applying rate-window rule on ap-southeast-1. Please confirm before I push:
```
{
  "account": "acct_8hjK2",
  "region": "ap-southeast-1",
  "allowlist": ["34.120.45.0/24","34.120.46.0/24"],
  "qps_sustained": "75",
  "qps_peak": "200",
  "start": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-04-15T23:59:00Z",
  "auto_revoke": true
}
```

Sachin (Harvestly): Confirmed. We'll monitor and report any errors; thanks.

Devin (SRE): I'll add a temporary alert to our routing dashboard for this account (latency + 5xx spikes) and ensure fallback policy to the small-host pool if we hit capacity.

Marta (CS): Perfect. Post-mortem note: capture token-level cost impact for the two-week pilot so ops can reconcile billing. @finance FYI.

Alec (Infra): Pushed change at 2026-03-30T18:02Z to staging, will push to prod on 2026-03-31 01:00Z unless objections.

Devin (SRE): No objections from SRE side. :thumbsup:

Marta (CS): Great — closing loop. Will follow up after 04/15 with usage summary and renewal risk flagged if they exceed tier.
